mappings.coverage: whole orchestration with explicit scanner/dispatch/audio services
mappings.qualification: This recovers configuration orchestration, not the native file scanner, dispatcher, bank loader or audio device. Valid parser/token/bank backing, adequate capacity and terminating service sequence are required. The token-reader return value is ignored; dispatch tests current token first byte. Missing file still proceeds through bank terminator, load, zero mask, optional mask application and finish. Bank terminator touches only its first16bytes. Post-load flag is reread after clearing200mask bytes. Services are synchronous and may mutate shared state. Managed replay pending.
mappings.comparisonStatus: Original native/model differential passed; managed replay pending.
